facts.fact: L'Oeil du Sahel reports that the BCEAO's 2 October 2026 communique, covering Mali as a UEMOA state, sets binding rules for interoperable e-money transfers from 2 November 2026.
L'Oeil du Sahel reports that the BCEAO communique requires interoperable e-money transfers in UEMOA, including Mali, to be routed through PI-SPI from 2 November 2026.

L'Oeil du Sahel cites the UMOA banking commission as listing Orange Finances Mobiles Mali and Sama Money among Mali's e-money institutions, with 162.680 billion FCFA of e-money outstanding at end 2024.
facts.system: Orange Finances Mobiles Mali; Sama Money
